title: Cripps Mission timeline
subject: History
caption: Timeline of key events of the 1942 Cripps Mission
altText: A chronological timeline showing nine milestones: the mission's dispatch from London on March 3, arrival in New Delhi on March 24, drafting of proposals on April 1, announcement of a Constituent Assembly proposal on April 10, the Indian National Congress rejecting the proposals on April 20, the All‑India Muslim League giving conditional support on April 25, the British Government restating the offer on May 1, the mission being withdrawn on May 15, and the subsequent rise of the Quit India movement on June 1.
